## Source / 来源

- Repository URL:
- Exact SKILL.md URL:
- Upstream license evidence URL (and any ambiguity):
- Installation documentation URL:

## Use case / 适用场景

Describe a concrete developer task and why this skill belongs here. Choose frontend, backend, database, or engineering practices.

## Installation / 安装

Provide the exact upstream method and prerequisites. State whether you only reviewed instructions or actually executed them. Do not include credentials.

## Evidence / 验证依据

- [ ] I located a real SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter.
- [ ] I checked license evidence and disclosed any uncertainty.
- [ ] I linked upstream installation instructions without inventing a command.
- [ ] I distinguished metadata review, installation execution, and effectiveness evaluation.
- [ ] I have not copied third-party skill content into this issue.

Optional evaluation report: record source revision, environment, agent/version, task, outcome, and limitations.
